paragraphs: Mentioned at the beginning of chapter 1 of Derekh Eretz Rabbah: “R' Yose ben Taddai, a man of Tiberias, asked R' Gamliel this question.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: ד״א רבה is read contextually as Derekh Eretz Rabbah; the earlier Devarim Rabbah suggestion is withdrawn. רפ״א gives beginning of chapter 1, without fresh edition verification.

ר״ג is contextually read as Gamliel with the title left R'; the abbreviation alone does not establish Rabban rather than another full title or which Gamliel. Both Yose occurrences also remain R'. Tanna and man of Tiberias are supplied qualifiers, not title-expansion or identity evidence. The source quotes the question-introduction only, without the question itself.
